corrected_prompt:
Candid iPhone 15 Pro photo, vertical 9:16, real skin texture, everything sharp. Look: a POV dramatization with hands only and never a face; a warm evening home office lit by a tungsten desk lamp from the upper left, soft shadows, natural skin; the hand always in a mustard-yellow knit sleeve; muted warm palette of walnut, warm grey, mustard and paper white, red only on the price stickers.
Reference images: none attached; this prompt is the only input. All positions are measured down from the top edge and across from the left edge of the frame.
Subject: three identical plain white tall narrow paper sheets lying flat in a row on a desk, seen from straight above, side by side with small gaps, filling the band from 30% to 62% of the frame height (x 6% to 94%); each sheet about 28% of the frame width and 32% of the frame height; the set appears once.
Hands: one adult right hand, the viewer's own, wrist in a mustard-yellow knit sleeve, entering from the bottom edge at the lower right (x 60% to 90%, y 60% to 100%). Its index finger and thumb pinch the bottom left corner of the rightmost sheet, the corner away from its sticker, and lift that corner about 2 cm off the desk. The hand stays below the last heading with clear paper between them; no letter touches the hand, fingers or sleeve; the hand covers no heading letter and no part of any sticker. Exactly one hand with five fingers; no other hand.
Action: thumb and index finger pinch the rightmost sheet's bottom left corner; the corner lifts 2 cm, seen as a small curl of the paper and a soft shadow under it; the other two sheets lie flat.
Props: the three sheets are copies, identical in layout, words and type. On each, three headings stacked in heavy black block capitals below the sticker row, each on one single line that is never wrapped and never wider than 85% of the sheet's width (letters about 4% of the sheet height, the same size for all three headings), with a few plain grey bars (not letters) under each heading. Each sheet has one plain round red sticker in its top right corner, above the first heading so that it touches no heading letter, with no writing on it: the left sheet's sticker is the largest (about 9% of the frame width), the middle one smaller (about 6.5%), the right one the smallest (about 4%). That sticker size is the only difference between the sheets.
Text: on each of the three sheets, the same three headings, top to bottom, all below the sticker: "PROGRAM" at the top of the text area, then "WEEKLY CALLS" in the middle, then "A PROMISE" in the lower middle. Upper case, exactly these words, spelled the same on all three sheets. The bars under them are plain grey bars, not letters. Nothing covers any heading letter.
Setting: a warm walnut desk seen from straight above in the evening; nothing else on the desk.
Camera: flat lay, straight down at 90 degrees, 9:16. The top 30% of the frame is bare dark walnut wood with nothing on it. The headings and stickers sit between 30% and 56% from the top, inside 6% side margins; below 62% there is only the hand and wood.
Continuity: none, this is the first frame of the reel.
Negatives: no face; no logo, brand or app name; no digits, prices or currency signs anywhere, the stickers stay blank; no words other than the three headings; no fourth sheet; no pens, phones or cups on the desk; no second hand.
note: Corrected prompt changes only the Hands line (right hand, rightmost sheet, FL-01 line) and the Action line ('rightmost sheet's'). Packet media: none.
